assertion_review.failure_condition: Changing the joint recurrence gamma derivative or disabling the eligible source series breaks the retained independent 60-digit expected values; a NaN regular sentinel forces coverage of the series.

Incorrectly selecting the source expansion for interior, unconverged or cylindrical cases fails the 3.25 fallback sentinel; this compares the supplied regular value intentionally and proves branch routing only, not physical accuracy; returning regular unconditionally is caught by the paired high-precision test.

Reference nonconvergence fails explicitly; restoring the old zero-modulus expressions makes value finiteness fail for four cases, as recorded; incorrect analytic values fail against separately integrated rings; nonzero symmetry values fail the explicit zeros.

Nonconverged references fail; removing the root/source/target conditioning loses agreement at the prescribed small radii and fails the independent field-norm or flux errors; the high-precision evaluator computes ring elliptics independently of sheet.py.

The distance assertions qualify the fixed geometric probes only; replacing endpoint behavior by a finite clamp or altering its logarithmic coefficient fails monotonic growth or the independent asymptotic coefficient; distance assertions alone are not implementation guards.
Allowing a zero denominator or singular unselected expression to poison jacfwd makes a geometry tangent nonfinite; a finite but incorrect tangent is not detected.

Centroid-on-edge geometry fails positive distance; restored zero-radius source defects fail the scalar/packed finite checks under --require-finite; before-census.log is the positive detection control for the zero after count.
The current-worktree target is refused; a source retaining the introduced guard or missing the expected unguarded expression fails mutation identity assertions.

findings.text: non-blocking: _graded_precise_ring_reference duplicates the panel integration, bisection and convergence loop already owned by scripts/edge_sheet/reference.py:_panel_integral and sheet_reference; its 50-digit ring evaluation is justified by the small-loop precision defect, but the shared reference owner should accept or own that evaluator so the refinement algorithms do not drift; this does not block the independently qualified production repair.

justifications.fit: nova/biot/sheet.py:1457 and :1593 follow the existing NumPy/JAX shared-owner pattern with held inactive arguments, and the new definitions describe mechanisms without forbidden source labels.
